info.title: wasm.fyi benchmark API
info.description: Public, read-only discovery and current/source-pinned historical WebAssembly benchmark queries; authenticated atomic capture publication. Start with /api/summary, then request a bounded /api/matrix or /api/history/summary scope. Durations are nanoseconds and resource sizes are bytes. Metric statuses are independent: only ok has a value; other values are null. Never compare measurements from different machines or unmatched workload cohorts as a controlled benchmark. Unknown and repeated query fields are rejected. JSON responses have a 1 MiB ceiling. All GET endpoints support exact ETag revalidation. The retired /api/v1/* and /admin/v1/* routes are not aliases.

get.description: Main workloads only; feature probes and host-call mechanisms are excluded. Defaults to steady/corpus/shared/geo. get.description: Each runtime snaps inward to its first and last measured dates inside fromDate/toDate and the optional from/to source window. get.description: Follow nextCursor until null. Cursors survive server restarts and bind one platform revision: changes on another platform do not invalidate them, but changes to this platform, including another phase, do. A 409 revision_changed requires restarting the traversal. No pagination snapshots are retained. Prefer compact matrix/timeline endpoints for browsing without raw samples.

post.description: Privileged publisher endpoint, not required for reading data. Body must be application/json and at most 1 MiB. Publication is atomic; equal-time and older cells are ignored. Schema validation is supplemented by service-side consistency checks for statuses, values, sample counts and sampling policies. Read-only deployments reject publication.

403.description: Read-only mode; capture publication is disabled.

413.description: Capture body exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

publisherToken.description: Publisher credential required only for capture publication; public GET endpoints require no authentication.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Exact ETag from the same request and representation. A matching validator returns 304 without a body.

Workload.name: workload
Workload.description: Exact workload identifier, including its category prefix.

MatrixLimit.name: limit
MatrixLimit.description: Maximum scalar rows in a page; reduce it if the response exceeds the 1 MiB ceiling.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Use the previous nextOffset. A nonzero offset requires revision and unchanged filters.

Revision.name: revision
Revision.description: Returned scope revision. Required with offset > 0; a mismatch returns 409. Changing filters also changes this revision.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive UTC source-date lower bound; unbounded when omitted. Must not follow to.

To.name: to
To.description: Inclusive UTC source-date upper bound; unbounded when omitted.

Engines.name: engines
Engines.description: Comma-separated engine identifiers. Omit to include all available engines. Duplicates are deduplicated; do not repeat the query field.

Baseline.name: baseline
Baseline.description: Optional comparison baseline engine. Aggregate ratios are null when no usable baseline is selected. Included in history scope normalization.

Weighting.name: weighting
Weighting.description: corpus gives each group equal total weight; workload gives each contributing workload equal weight.

Cohort.name: cohort
Cohort.description: shared compares the common measured cohort; per-engine uses each engine's available measurements.

Average.name: average
Average.description: Geometric or arithmetic mean. rssAverage always uses its arithmetic workload-phase mean policy.

HistoryWorkload.name: workload
HistoryWorkload.description: Exact workload, excluding features/. For call metrics, must be mechanisms/host-to-wasm-call or mechanisms/wasm-host-wasm-loop as applicable to the selected metric.

FromDate.name: fromDate
FromDate.description: Comparison lower bound. Each engine snaps inward to its first measured date on or after this day. Must not follow toDate.

ToDate.name: toDate
ToDate.description: Comparison upper bound. Each engine snaps inward to its last measured date on or before this day.

NotModified.description: The exact If-None-Match value matches this representation. No response body.

ETag.description: Representation validator. Send this exact quoted value in If-None-Match on the same request and content encoding.

Vary.description: ETags differ between identity and gzip representations.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid query, unknown/repeated query field, invalid cursor, or invalid request data. Inspect error.code and error.message.

NotFound.description: Unknown platform or observation; compact browsing endpoints also return 404 when SQL storage is unavailable.

RevisionChanged.description: error.code is revision_changed. Dataset or bound scope changed. Discard partial pages and restart from the first page; for a batch, retry the complete request.

ResponseTooLarge.description: Encoded response exceeds 1 MiB. Reduce limit or narrow filters/date range. This error is plain text, not the JSON Problem envelope.

RateLimited.description: Request rate or concurrency budget exceeded. Back off and retry.

Retry-After.description: Wait this many seconds when supplied for a rate limit. Concurrency limits may omit it.

RequestTimeout.description: Request canceled or exceeded the service deadline. Retry with a narrower scope if needed.
